title: Coronal Hole Watch
text:
🕳 Coronal Hole Watch — September 19, 2026

Sunny noticed a prominent dark region in the current EUV imagery that's consistent with a coronal hole. For now, there's no established high-speed stream headed toward Earth.

🌎 Earth relevance: Not established yet.
💨 CH-HSS status: No Earth arrival forecast yet.
📡 Solar wind now: 438 km/s (Moderate)

Probably nothing. Probably.

Coronal holes are regions of open magnetic field that can feed faster solar-wind streams into interplanetary space. ☀💨

Image: NASA SDO/AIA — 193 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center + NASA SDO
